body:
## Summary

- add a fail-closed, repository-wide dependency freshness inventory and run it before release change detection
- configure daily grouped Dependabot updates for npm, Actions, Docker, Compose, and Helm
- update all 17 stale declarations found in the initial 138-record scan and expand coverage to 148 declarations
- refresh six safe operational CLIs in long-lived containers through the existing idle-only updater
- preserve the investigation, upstream release logs, registry evidence, reports, and ruleset snapshots in a case study

Fixes #2264.

## Root cause

The reported `gh-upload-log` contradiction combined three issues: its version was hard-coded, GitHub release 0.9.0 existed even though npm publication failed, and running containers had no update path for operational CLIs. More broadly, dependency declarations were split among manifests, `use-m` maps, Dockerfiles, workflows, setup inputs, base images, and embedded binaries with no common freshness postcondition.

The upstream publication path was independently corrected in link-foundation/gh-upload-log#41 and npm now serves 0.9.1. This investigation also reported the residual formatter false-success as link-foundation/gh-upload-log#43 and the broken published `gh-load-issue@0.3.2` entry point as link-foundation/gh-load-issue#18.

## Implementation

- `scripts/check-dependency-freshness.mjs` resolves stable npm and GitHub releases with retries, deduplication, precision-aware policies, and fail-closed errors.
- The required `detect-changes` job runs freshness first, while `Pipeline Status` observes the result.
- `.github/dependabot.yml` proposes one daily multi-ecosystem update. All five ecosystems explicitly opt out of GitHub's default three-day cooldown so automated remediation agrees with the immediate freshness gate; the scoped zizmor exception documents that decision.
- Main ruleset 7927725 now strictly requires the GitHub Actions `Pipeline Status` context. The existing deletion, non-fast-forward, and pull-request rules were preserved, and before/after API snapshots are committed with the investigation.
- The idle updater now includes `claude-profiles`, `gh-setup-git-identity`, `gh-pull-all`, `gh-load-issue`, `gh-load-pull-request`, and `gh-upload-log` while preserving its active-task guard, process lock, throttle, allow/deny lists, and per-tool isolation.
- Broken `--version` entry points fall back to `bun pm ls -g`, allowing an installed package to remain maintainable without masking the upstream executable defect.
- `command-stream` 0.24.1 activates the quote-context fix introduced in 0.20.0; the issue #2119 regression now proves quoted and bare interpolations both preserve exact arguments.

## Reproduction and verification

Before the fix, the archived scan found 17 stale declarations (`121/138` current). The final live scan reports `148/148` current.

- `npx --yes --package npm@11.19.1 -- npm test` — all 491 selected test files passed
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run format:check`
- `npm run check:duplication`
- `npm run check:secrets`
- `npm audit --audit-level=low` — 0 vulnerabilities
- `node scripts/check-dependency-freshness.mjs` — 148/148 current
- actionlint 1.7.12 and Helm 4.3 lint checks passed against the updated workflow/chart inputs

The complete implementation run passed the 491-file suite, both production image builds, and in-container tool verification before the status was made required: [Checks and release 35488145037](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/35488145037). The final evidence head `88550346` is also fully green:

- [Checks and release 35489282414](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/35489282414), including the required [`Pipeline Status`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/35489282414/job/106021542087)
- [Security 35489282253](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/35489282253)
- [Workflows 35489282241](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/35489282241)
- [Broken Link Checker 35489282243](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/35489282243)

The new regression uses a mocked registry for deterministic stale/current/error cases, inventories the real repository, verifies workflow and Dependabot wiring, simulates the `gh-upload-log` 0.1.0-to-0.9.1 transition, and proves a broken executable can still be refreshed from package-manager metadata.

## Evidence

See [`docs/case-studies/issue-2264`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-2264-0a04b3d4fcdc/docs/case-studies/issue-2264) for the timeline, root-cause analysis, full evidence index, upstream reports, and compressed workflow logs.

This is a non-visual CI/runtime maintenance change, so screenshots are not applicable.
title: Enforce dependency freshness across CI and running containers
